proyecto.contexto:
STL Studio is a small local web app that sits between you and an AI model and turns the model into your project's assistant director. Building alone, or in a small team, projects rarely die from a lack of ideas: they die from scattered attention. Ten chats open, half-finished plans, a «shall I proceed?» lost three sessions ago, and every new chat starting from zero, politely asking you to explain everything again.

The STL method fixes that with a single channel. Everything you tell the director (a comment, a voice note, a question, a decision) goes into the Studio. On each review, which only you request, the director reads it all, keeps the route toward your goal and gives each person one mission at a time, with its why and a button to the exact place. You decide; the director proposes, orders the work and executes only what you approved, with tests and local commits.

The memory lives in your project's own repository, on a separate stl branch, so nothing depends on a chat's context: the model can forget, the project can't. Fewer tabs, more finished things.

This project is your Studio: to adjust it to the way you work, select it and ask the director in the Inbox.

pasos.texto: This project is your Studio, and you don't have to change anything to get started: you can go straight to your own project. We recommend using it as it comes for a while, so you get to know it and discover what is designed to make your work easier: it comes set up to make your work as easy and orderly as possible and to take you to your project's goal in the best way. If you later find something you want to adjust, select this project and ask the director for the adjustment from here.

It comes set up the way its author considers best, and each person can change it.
